criteria.requirement: Before finalizing SKU reconciliation, ask about duplicate SKUs in the file and in the existing database. If duplicate-policy has not been disclosed, a reasonable request should select that fixed branch; do not invent a policy or conclude a fully specified plan prematurely.

After the actual owner policy has been disclosed, faithfully apply its decisions for duplicates within input and existing data, pre-write checks, preservation and retry behavior. Before disclosure, do not infer or reveal a fixed policy. Request the available owner decision rather than treating the missing policy as a terminal insufficient_information outcome.

Use real APIs: insert_multiple can reduce writes for new documents; upsert handles one document and updates every matching document; there is no upsert_multiple. Discuss validation, backup, finite input normalization, lookup/update/insert strategy, batching/buffering tradeoffs and normal flush/reopen checks. Do not call repeated upserts a single atomic transaction.

Deliver an ordered reviewable plan with checks and failure/retry boundaries. Do not implement or execute the importer, claim measured speedup, delete data to gain speed, or promise multi-process safety.

comparison: Evaluate factual grounding, actual business behavior and constraints. Accept concise or equivalent valid answers; do not grade keyword matching, answer length, or similarity to a reference answer.
